name: Sverkhnovaya!
source:
The events take place in a parallel universe. Shurik, like many kids of the romantic socialism era, dreams of becoming a cosmonaut and a scientist, even a super-cosmonaut and a super-scientist! And he throws all his energy into realizing his dream. But along with this passion, the guy develops a specific philosophy... His worldview and hobbies begin to distance him from others, turning him into an outcast and an object of ridicule - and from this grows a multitude of problems in his life. But a future cybernetician must be able to overcome difficulties!

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2377219233]Steam[/url]]
